hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A subarray is special if it contains zero adjacent pairs with matching parity.

hints.title: Violation Array
hints.text: Mark an indicator bad[i] = 1 if nums[i] and nums[i - 1] have identical parity, otherwise 0.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Queries
hints.text: Compute prefix sums of the violation indicators. Range [from, to] is special if prefix[to] - prefix[from] == 0.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear prefix sum precomputation with O(1) query evaluation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning each query range takes O(q * n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for prefix sum array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use prefix sums of bad adjacent pairs to answer interval validity in constant time.
